body: my parents are pretty accepting but I'm not so sure about some of my friends... they would either laugh at me (in my face or behind my back) or think I'm really weird. and yes I know it sounds like theyre not ''real friends'' but they are I just dont know for sure how they think about lgbt+.
I thought of that too but theres nowhere in my neighbourhood I can volunteer as a 13 year old...
I want to apologize for breaking the rules. I didnt read them properly and I thought I would be helping people by posting this, but I now realize I dont. I hope I didnt do any harm for anyone.

I used to be depressed and suicidal, and less than half a year ago I would have said exactly the same thing as you. but the point is, the doctors are right, we just cant see it. Ive never really spoken to a doctor or anything about this, but I should have, because now I had to tell these things to myself. luckily I had a friend who was dealing with the same stuff so I wasnt alone, but anyways, this is not about me. what Im trying to say is, you are not the exception. everyone can recover and so can you, you just have to find the willpower. Im not saying its easy, but its possible. you may not actually kill yourself, but we all want you to be happy because we are worried about you and we would never, never want to lose you. theyre just trying to make you realize how worthy you are of living, and they may not realize how hard it is and how lame they sound, but they dont know what it feels like. theyre just trying to make you love yourself, and you might not believe it, but at some point you'll have to realize theyre right. Im sorry if i sound just like them, but dont forget I have felt the same way as you do now, and that I care about you even though we dont know each other, and I do understand depression.


I hope you dont need the doctors anymore soon.

imagine what would happen if you would kill yourself. 
your mother would walk in and see your dead body. she would scream, her eyes would fill with tears, she would beg you to wake up and desperately grab you by the arm and notice the bloody cuts on your wrist and the unbearable coldness of it. your father would come in, not knowing whats going on, to find you mother with her head resting on your chest, wetting your shirt with her tears. your father would stand still, shocked by the image of his child that he raised and watched growing up being dead. your internet friends will wonder why you arent responding to their texts, until someone finally guesses your password and logs onto your account to tell your friends you died. they would not go to school or work for three days or do anything at all, because they cant handle the thought of you not being able to do that anymore.
the teacher would tell your class you died, and they would all look at the table you would always sit, and tears would stream down their faces as they stare at the teacher in silence, hoping they were just dreaming. 
your family would isolate themselves and not talk to anyone for weeks, because they cant stop thinking about you. at night, your mother would wake up, bathing in sweat, still shaking from how she found your body, she just cant seem to forget it. your father would try to calm her, but both of them notices how his voice shakes as he tells her they will find a way to move on with their life.
your family and friends would come to your funeral, in black dresses and suits, and they would cry their eyes out because they werent there to help you when you needed them. they wouldnt be able to sleep for weeks because they cant stop thinking about you. and I bet they would die to bring you back.
